claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tinidazole is a nitroimidazole prodrug that requires reductive activation in anaerobic/hypoxic cells; at 2.5 uM in a 5-day aerobic pooled viability screen against human cancer lines it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing attributable to nonspecific nitro-reductive or physicochemical effects rather than a shared targeted mechanism.
